title: Add example Private deployment tfvars + walkthrough for design partners (sanitized)
author: Bruno Silva
description: Context: Solutions Engineering has repeatedly asked for a concrete starting point for VPC module inputs during design partner pilots. This PR adds sanitized example tfvars for two representative regulated-enterprise topologies (strict egress + endpoints-heavy; and hybrid connectivity placeholder) along with a short walkthrough that explains what to change vs what should remain as-is. The goal is to reduce back-and-forth during discovery/pilot kickoff and to encode Redwood-validated defaults without leaking customer-identifying details. Safety note: examples intentionally avoid customer names, account IDs, on-prem IP ranges, IAM ARNs, domain names, and any internal hostnames; all values are either generic placeholders or clearly marked as "REPLACE_ME". Includes a reviewer discussion on what is acceptable to ship in-repo for alpha and guidance on how to share these examples externally (copy/paste into customer repo, do not link to internal paths).
commits: docs(examples): add sanitized tfvars examples for design partner pilots
docs: add walkthrough + variable mapping table for module inputs
chore: add pre-commit checks to ensure examples contain no forbidden tokens
docs: update root README with link to examples and sharing guidance
notable_snippets: private-vpc.auto.tfvars.example includes: region, vpc_cidr, private/public subnet cidrs per AZ, enable_flow_logs, flow_logs_destination, enable_vpc_endpoints, endpoints list (ecr.api, ecr.dkr, s3 gateway, sts, logs, monitoring, autoscaling), and a minimal "installer_execution_role_name" placeholder (no ARN).

docs/private-vpc/design-partner-walkthrough.md contains a step-by-step: copy template -> fill in cidrs/azs -> choose NAT strategy -> enable endpoints + private DNS -> apply -> hand outputs to installer (cluster subnets, endpoint readiness).
scripts/redaction_scan.sh fails CI if examples contain patterns like 12-digit account IDs, known customer names, corporate domains, or strings matching /vpn|dx/ with concrete CIDRs.
ci_summary: CI ran terraform fmt/validate, tflint, checkov (soft-fail for examples directory), and a lightweight redaction scan job. Integration test harness was not triggered (no module logic changes). All required checks passed.
checks: checkov: pass (no high/critical; 2 medium accepted for examples-only resources)
review_conversation: Markus Klein (SE): This is exactly what we need for kickoff. Request: add a clear section on what we can safely share with customers vs internal-only notes. Also rename "acme"/"northstar" to something generic in paths; we should not have customer identifiers in the repo even if sanitized.

Bruno Silva (author): +1. I’ll switch to design-partner-1/2 directories, remove any lingering names, and add a "Sharing guidance" section that says to copy into the customer repo and never ask them to reference our internal examples directly.

Hanae Suzuki (Security): Please confirm there are no real account IDs, real domains, or real on-prem CIDRs. Also watch out for leaked internal hostnames in comments. Suggest adding an automated grep in CI for common patterns (12-digit ids, .corp, etc.).

Bruno Silva (author): Agreed. Added scripts/redaction_scan.sh and wired it into the workflow. Also replaced the last remaining sample ARN with "REPLACE_ME". No domains included; Route53 private hosted zone is referenced as a generic variable only.

Victor Alvarez (Networking): On endpoints, please include both ecr.api and ecr.dkr and call out private DNS behavior explicitly in the walkthrough. Missing that is a common failure mode (see SUP-28411).
Bruno Silva (author): Updated design-partner-1 example to include both endpoints and added a troubleshooting note in the walkthrough: if image pulls fail, check ECR endpoints + private DNS enabled.
Irene Choi (Infra): CI: checkov is currently running across the whole repo; examples can cause noise. Can we scope checkov to modules/ and leave examples as non-blocking?
Bruno Silva (author): Done. Workflow now runs checkov required on modules/* and non-blocking on examples/*, but still blocks on redaction scan.

Kira Thompson (Docs): Walkthrough looks good. Minor: add a quick mapping table from tfvars -> module inputs -> installer preflight expectations. Also keep the doc as a single continuous page (avoid too many internal links).
Bruno Silva (author): Added a table section and kept links limited to repo-relative anchors.
release_notes: Added sanitized design-partner tfvars examples and a walkthrough under examples/design-partners/ for Redwood Private VPC pilots (alpha).
Added CI redaction scan to prevent accidental inclusion of sensitive/customer-identifying strings in examples.
